test_hash_struct: test the polars hash function on struct columns to verify deterministic hash values for struct dataframes
test_hash_deterministic: test that polars hash produces consistent deterministic hash values across repeated calls on the same struct dataframe
test_hash_struct_all_columns: test hashing a struct created from all columns of a polars dataframe using pl.struct and pl.all
test_hash_column_values: test that polars hash returns expected 64-bit unsigned integer hash values for struct column entries
test_hash_select_expression: test the polars select expression with pl.col hash method on a struct-typed column
